title: Focus Receipt And Work Order
description: Input shape for scripts/focus_receipt_audit.mjs — a Agent Harbor binder ch.18 'current product focus receipt' plus the work order it gates.

receipt.description: The current product focus receipt, per docs/architecture/agent-harbor-technical-binder/18-build-prescription-agent-launch-board.md.

decision.description: The one thing being built/prioritized right now.

now.description: The narrow, concrete slice being executed immediately.

whyNow.description: The reason this decision beats every other candidate at this moment.

evidence.description: The observed fact (operator complaint, failed probe, incident) that justifies whyNow.

notNow.description: Optional: explicit scope this decision deliberately excludes, so it isn't silently expected later.

cutSuspend.description: Optional: concepts/verbs/panels being frozen or removed so work doesn't fork into parallel truths.

firstVisibleProof.description: The exact observable artifact (screen, saved event, passing probe) that proves the decision produced something real.

statement.description: The concrete, checkable claim the proof must satisfy.

testableAgainstDaemonTruth.description: True only if the gate can be proven by rebuilding visible state from daemon/event truth after a restart or reconnect — never from a cached UI model.

killRevisitTrigger.description: The exact condition under which this decision is paused and forced back to re-litigation.

contextSwitchCount.description: Optional: how many independent chains/foundations this decision spans (see 'Agent count rule').

agentsNeeded.description: Optional: how many agents this decision launches, and in what wave.

owner.description: The named role or person accountable for this decision (e.g. 'Harbor Architect of Record').

reviewDate.description: ISO-8601 date by which this decision must be revisited with fresh evidence.

workOrder.description: The agent launch this focus receipt gates. Per ch.18: 'If a proposed chain cannot state its input, output, owner, and proof gate, it is a planning placeholder, not an agent launch.'

input.description: What the agent reads/consumes before starting (docs, prior chain outputs, fixtures).

output.description: What the agent must produce (ADR, schema, code, UI, report).

owner.description: Who is accountable for this specific chain's output, distinct from the receipt's overall owner.

proofGate.description: The concrete acceptance gate(s) this chain's output must pass before it counts as done.
